mapper.select: select a.defect_level, a.defect_time, a.conf_mode, a.deal_type, a.deal_info, a.image_path from t_defect_info a where 1 = 1

select a.device_id, b.device_mete_id, d.instance_id, e.cruise_result_id, f.state, f.identify_result as 'jieGuo', a.device_name , (CASE WHEN ISNULL(n.mete_name) AND ISNULL(m.inspection_name) AND ISNULL(k.preset_name) THEN '' WHEN ISNULL(n.mete_name) AND ISNULL(m.inspection_name) THEN k.preset_name WHEN ISNULL(n.mete_name) AND ISNULL(k.preset_name) THEN m.inspection_name WHEN ISNULL(m.inspection_name) AND ISNULL(k.preset_name) THEN n.mete_name WHEN ISNULL(m.inspection_name) THEN CONCAT(n.mete_name,'/',k.preset_name) WHEN ISNULL(k.preset_name) THEN CONCAT(n.mete_name,'/',m.inspection_name) END) AS instance_name, h.dict_note as identify_result, f.picpath, g.dict_note as cruise_result, e.cruise_time FROM t_std_device a, t_std_devicemete b, t_cruise_task_result_detail e, t_cruise_data_result f, t_dict_business g, t_dict_business h, t_cruise_point_instance d LEFT JOIN t_camera_preset k ON d.cruise_id = k.preset_id LEFT JOIN t_robot_inspection m ON m.inspection_id = d.cruise_id LEFT JOIN t_std_devicemete n ON n.device_mete_id = d.device_mete_id where a.device_id = b.device_id and a.custom_id = b.custom_id and b.device_mete_id = d.device_mete_id and e.instance_id = d.instance_id and e.cruise_result_id = f.cruise_result_id and g.dict_code = f.state and h.dict_code = f.identify_result
